newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: China Southern Airlines appoints Dutch GSA.
newsitem.headline: China Southern Airlines appoints Dutch GSA.

text.p: China Southern Airlines has appointed a cargo sales agent in the Netherlands, a spokesman for the airline said.
Global Airline Services, based in Amsterdam Schiphol, will take one cargo sales role for the Chinese airline. However, the airline also has its own office at the Dutch airport.
One of the newest arrivals to Schiphol, China Southern, operates twice-weekly from the Netherlands to Beijing and Guangzhou, with either a Boeing 767 or 777, he added.
The service started on November 26. - Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax+44 171 542 5017
